mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.5%, it indicates a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 4.5, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and housing market strength, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing slowdown, indicated by INDPRO falling below 100, signals reduced industrial output and weak corporate capital expenditure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts series (HOUST) indicates robust residential construction activity, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.0), wage pressures accelerate, leading to higher corporate costs and reduced profit margins, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary monetary policy that lowers real interest rates, thereby increasing equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over a 3-year rolling window.
